runs.name: American Water Works Company, Inc.; NYSE AWK, SEC CIK 0001410636; Camden, New Jersey holding company, the largest publicly traded US water and wastewater utility, regulated utilities in 14 states as one reportable segment with about 3.6 million active customers, military and municipal contract services as Other; Essential Utilities merger signed 2025-10-26, stock for stock at 0.305 AWK shares per Essential share, not closed, Pennsylvania PUC non-unanimous settlement petition 2026-09-15; Nexus Water Group systems purchase named in the 10-K; the 10-K names Essential, American States Water and California Water Service among rivals, Nexus flagged as not an SEC filer
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and the competitors derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (regulation and rate-making; capital intensity and its funding; acquisitions and the Essential merger; condemnation, contamination and affordability). Price **$141.10** (close 2026-10-27, aggregator, flagged) x **198,728,989 shares** (10-Q cover for the period ended 2026-06-30, accession 0001410636-26-000120; issued less treasury 198,728,208; 4,694,836 forward shares unsettled beside) = cap **$28,041M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). **Q1 IN** (14 regulated states, none above a quarter of revenue; orders of 2024 and 2025 allowing 9.60% to 10.20% on equity; a $46B to $48B ten-year capital plan). **Q2 IN on the franchise** (the 10-K: generally no direct competition, franchises and the cost of a second system; Regulated Businesses above all of consolidated net income 2023 to 2025, Other at a loss; the regulator-set return carried to Q3); ten-year mean ROE AWK 10.2% (11.0% with the 2021 sale gain), Essential 9.5%, American States Water 13.6%, California Water Service 8.9%. **Q3 weighs against narrowly** (capital added 2020 to 2025 earned about 5.3% after tax on operating earnings after depreciation, about the long Treasury; about 9% on added equity only through borrowing). **Q4 accounts clean, weighs against mildly** (featured adjusted EPS below GAAP every year; the 7% to 9% EPS growth target carried to Q5). **Q5 integrity IN**, ability weighs for modestly. **Q6 weighs against in both parts** (TSR 2021 to 2025 $93.81 per $100 against $158.66 for the pay peer group; dividends paid while stock is issued, $1,688M in 2023 and $476M in 2026; an anti-dilutive buyback naming no price, written back as weighing against; issuance at about $133 and $139.66 above the top of the range weighs for on that line; pay EPS keeps favorable weather and added back a $45M foundation gift in 2021; the all-stock merger STOP not triggered, AWK above its range, value given $8,195M against Essential's $8,125M at intrinsic value). **Q7 OUT, on the floor and above the top of the range**: equity-only central (a regulated utility); owner cash 2021 to 2025 after the depreciation guess **$999.6M a year** with the 2022 tax on the HOS and New York sale gains added back and the proceeds left out (a CONVENTION of the run; literal $943.6M), negative after all spending every year (-$449M to -$1,340M); growth shown 9.50% cut to sales growth of 6.94% under (f); growth spending $2,285M in year one to $4,180M in year ten; utility debt credit $919.6M a year at a 55.4% cap (the business's own long-term debt share, the stated allowed shares covering under half the rate base), not binding. Value range **$94.91 to $98.84 a share equity-only (central)**; 3.56% to 4.96% at the price, below the 5.30% sovereign; **fair price $39.41 equity-only, central**; all-equity ends -$11.13 and -$61.56 at ten percent, no positive fair price; beside: literal window $89.59 to $89.56, (c) literal $89.59 to $101.41, Essential merger as if closed $94.66 no-growth. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed. Balance sheet 2016 to 2025: debt $7.2B to $15.8B (2.2x) against equity 2.1x, the debt share held at 56% to 63% by new equity; goodwill a shrinking tenth of equity; working capital in deficit; pre-tax interest coverage 3.3x (2025); debt to capitalization 0.59 under a 0.70 covenant; $835M termination fee payable in certain circumstances. Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: about 5.3% after tax on added capital, TSR well below the pay peers, a pay EPS that keeps weather and adds back a foundation gift, an unpriced buyback beside dividends paid while issuing. Framework gaps for the operator: divestitures inside the window under (a) and (c); the utility cap without a stated total rate base; (f)'s highest share of sales depending on the span read (27.0% in the statements read, 28.2% in 2017 XBRL); Q6's all-stock STOP needing Q7's range and its reach to a signed unclosed deal; no measure of decent for Q3 at a regulated utility; depreciation as the maintenance guess when replaced pipe is half debt-financed. Could not get: a total rate base, buyback prices from 2015, directors' purchases, a 10-Q for 2026-09-30 (not yet filed). Ordering departure declared by the analyst: the Q7 arithmetic was run in the research folder while Q1 to Q4 were open, headed COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE from the Q2 commit on, the Q1 commit holding an unheaded copy; written into the run only at Q7. Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths, one per question, last `e382e92e`. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, no citation slip, 102 quote-id pairs matched by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: an ARCB research folder name in git status, an AQN-U commit subject, memory index queue lines; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: the largest US water and wastewater utility, the castle standing on state franchises, but owner cash is negative after all spending every year, added capital earns about the long Treasury after tax and the central case returns 3.56% at the price; value range $94.91 to $98.84 equity-only against $141.10. Fair $39.41 equity-only, central; all-equity not positive; armed.
